data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: For each unresolved thread, a sonnet sub-agent addresses the concern in code or via REST reply, then resolveReviewThread is called
- DD4: Settling heuristic — done only when CI green AND zero unresolved threads AND no new threads in last 120s
- DD5: Loop bounds — max dispatch count (default 10) and wall-clock budget (default 30 min); escalate to user on either limit

## Description
Add a new phase function `_phase_resolve_threads` to `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh`. Wire it into the main flow between auto-merge enqueue (`_phase_merge` returning success) and `_phase_poll`'s MERGED-state check. The phase loops until settled, escalates on bounds.

## Files to Modify
- `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh` (MODIFY)

## Loop Algorithm

```
_phase_resolve_threads(pr_number, pr_url):
    max_dispatches = read merge.pr_max_thread_dispatches (default 10)
    max_wait      = read merge.pr_thread_resolution_max_wait_seconds (default 1800)
    quiet_window  = read merge.pr_thread_quiet_window_seconds (default 120)
    interval      = read merge.pr_poll_interval_seconds (default 30)

    dispatches = 0
    start_ts = now
    last_thread_seen_ts = 0
    last_thread_count = 0

    loop:
      threads = _pr_fetch_unresolved_threads(pr_number)
      ci_state = _pr_check_ci_conclusion(pr_number)  // green | failed | pending
      now_ts = now

      if len(threads) > last_thread_count: last_thread_seen_ts = now_ts
      last_thread_count = len(threads)

      // settling heuristic
      if ci_state == green AND len(threads) == 0 AND (now_ts - last_thread_seen_ts) >= quiet_window:
         return 0  // settled

      // bounds
      if dispatches >= max_dispatches: escalate("dispatch_cap", pr_url, threads); return 1
      if (now_ts - start_ts) >= max_wait: escalate("wall_clock", pr_url, threads); return 1

      // dispatch one sub-agent per unresolved thread (bounded by remaining budget)
      for thread in threads:
        if dispatches >= max_dispatches: break
        result = llm-api-call.sh --model sonnet --prompt-template plugins/dso/scripts/prompts/pr-comment-responder.md \
                  --context thread_id=...,thread_body=...,pr_url=...,repo_root=...,file_path=...,line_range=...,diff_context=...
        dispatches += 1
        case result.action:
          code_change: stage commit (delegated; see Constraints below)
          reply:       _pr_post_thread_reply(pr_number, comment_id, reply_text)
          escalate:    skip — leave thread for user; reply with escalation note
        // idempotent precheck inside resolve helper
        _pr_resolve_thread(thread_id)

      sleep interval
```

Escalation envelope (printed to stderr, exit 1):
```
ESCALATE:thread_resolution REASON:<dispatch_cap|wall_clock> PR:<url> UNRESOLVED:<comma-separated thread IDs> DISPATCHES:<n>
```

## Constraints
- Sub-agent dispatched via `llm-api-call.sh` (already in `plugins/dso/scripts/`); orchestrator wraps the call in a stub-friendly indirection (env var `_LLM_DISPATCH_CMD` overridable for tests)
- Code-change actions: the sub-agent stages changes, then `_phase_resolve_threads` runs `git push origin HEAD` (push to the PR branch). The push triggers CI restart — handled by T5
- All structured stdout/stderr lines must use existing logging conventions (`INFO:`, `ERROR:`)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] `_phase_resolve_threads` defined and invoked between merge phase and poll phase
  Verify: grep -q '^_phase_resolve_threads()' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh && grep -q '_phase_resolve_threads' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] T1 RED tests for settling heuristic + dispatch cap + wall-clock cap now pass (GREEN)
  Verify: bash tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh -k 'settling_heuristic|dispatch_count_cap|wall_clock_cap'
- [ ] Three new config keys readable via read-config.sh with documented defaults
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh merge.pr_max_thread_dispatches; bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh merge.pr_thread_resolution_max_wait_seconds; bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh merge.pr_thread_quiet_window_seconds
- [ ] Escalation emits structured ESCALATE: line on stderr with PR url and unresolved thread IDs
  Verify: assertion in T1 test_dispatch_count_cap_triggers_escalation captures stderr containing "ESCALATE:thread_resolution"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet to opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: T4: _phase_resolve_threads loop with settling heuristic and bounds
